name: Viv
from: Photo: on a waterfront terrace in Lisbon with a jug of sangria.

ranemon.name: Vivemon

signature.name: Sangria Jug
signature.idea: Pours a round for itself: heals a third of its HP and raises its Spirit.

ranemon.entry: Found only where there is sun, a sea view and a jug on the table. It has been on holiday for three years and calls it a couple of days away.

name: Meg
from: Photo: at a picnic in the park, with a drinks pouch.

ranemon.name: Megamon

signature.name: Mega Pouch
signature.idea: Bursts a festival drinks pouch over the foe. Raises its own Attack and Spirit.

ranemon.entry: Mega evolves at the first sign of sun in a London park. The stone round its neck is a drinks pouch it has never once finished.

name: Annie
from: Photo: at Framingham, Kilshane House, by a red Vespa with a glass of red.

ranemon.name: Anniemon

signature.name: Scooter By
signature.idea: Arrives on a red Vespa and leaves before the bill. Always goes first.

ranemon.entry: Only ever seen at the good table. Rides a little red scooter between garden parties and has never once spilled its red.

name: Esme
from: Photo: on a terrace above the sea, with a spritz.

ranemon.name: Esmeon

signature.name: Spritz O’Clock
signature.idea: It is always five o’clock somewhere. Hits hard and may Fluster the foe.

ranemon.entry: An Eevee that evolved by the sea at golden hour. It wears its wrap like a tail and its smile can be seen from the next terrace.

name: Dr Batool
from: Photo: in her gown and mortarboard, admitted as a Member of the RCOG.

ranemon.name: Batoolmon

signature.name: Bedside Manner
signature.idea: Heals half its HP and cures its status. The foe is told to rest and lowers its guard.

ranemon.entry: Has delivered more Ranemon than any trainer in London. Graduated top of its year and still turned up to the ceremony on time.

name: Ana
from: Photo: at a summer garden party, with a pint in a plastic cup.

ranemon.name: Anamon

signature.name: Golden Pint
signature.idea: Raises a pint to the sun. Heals a quarter of its HP and raises its Speed.

ranemon.entry: Comes out when the sun does and is gone by the first cloud. Holds its pint so carefully it has never lost a drop on the grass.

name: Dr Bhav
from: Already in the game, in Greystones: her look is unchanged.

ranemon.name: Bhavemon

signature.name: Prescription
signature.idea: Writes the foe a prescription: it falls asleep. Its own Spirit rises.

ranemon.entry: Swore it hated Ranemon until it lost to one. Carries a prescription pad and an oat latte that never goes cold.

name: Sibeal
from: Already in the game, Norm’s owner: her look is unchanged.

ranemon.name: Sibealmon

signature.name: Walkies
signature.idea: Norm runs rings round the foe on his lead. Hits two to five times.

ranemon.entry: Never seen without its border collie. Will walk you round the whole of Dublin in the rain and say it was a lovely day for it.
